newsitem.title: UK: Takeover Panel probes Northern bidder -paper.
newsitem.headline: Takeover Panel probes Northern bidder -paper.

text.p: CE Electric, the company bidding for Northern Electric Plc, is under investigation by the Takeover Panel amid reports CE representatives were not identifying themselves correctly in phone calls to shareholders, the Times newspaper said.

Small shareholders of Northern have complained of harassment from CE Electric, a 70-percent owned unit of U.S. group CalEnergy Co Inc, the paper said. CE is mounting a telephone campaign to contact small shareholders at their homes.
The newspaper quoted a CE spokesman as saying the procedure was perfectly legal. The Takeover Panel is obliged to investigate compliants made during takeovers.
